Subject: Follow-up: Discovery call — Redwood & Sentinel Ventures

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — really appreciated the deep dive into your current inference costs and the latency issues you're seeing in US-West. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side: 

- Recap: You currently run a mix of on-prem GPU servers + cloud endpoints for customer-facing features; main constraints are tail latency during peak and unpredictable token costs.
- Value props we called out: predictable latency SLOs, unit-cost reductions via caching/batching, and simplified private deployment options for regulated customers.

Can you help with two items so we can map stakeholders & next steps?
1) Who is the economic buyer for this initiative (budget owner / VP/CFO-level)?
2) Who handles procurement / legal for pilot contracting (we want to make sure we route the right docs up front)?

If it's easier, an intro to the economic buyer + procurement owner would be ideal — I can include a short mutual action plan and proposal. I can also make time next week for a 30-min intro with Maya/CFO and your procurement lead.

Proposed next steps:
- Intro to economic buyer + procurement
- Quick pilot SOW + estimate (we can keep it scoped to a 6-week pilot)
- Security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence (we'll send the docs once we have procurement contact)

Attaching our one-pager for quick reference.

Thanks — talk soon,
